title: Sprint 2 - Kanban Board (Advanced State & Drag/Drop)
description: Graduate to complex, nested data structures and HTML5 Drag & Drop.

tickets.title: Board Layout
tickets.description: Render a 3-column Kanban board by mapping over complex nested objects.
tasks: Render a 3-column Kanban board by mapping over complex nested objects.
learning_objectives: Deeply nested mapping and advanced CSS Flexbox layouts.
tickets.evaluation: Logic Grader requires `.map` loops and correct CSS class usage (`.column`, `.task`). Target Design expects a vibrant blue/yellow/green UI.
common_mistakes: Using inline styles instead of CSS classes.
hints: Review the documentation for the hooks mentioned in the learning objectives.
Try logging your variables to the console to see their values.

tickets.title: HTML5 Drag & Drop
tickets.description: Make tasks draggable using the browser's native API.
tasks: Make tasks draggable using the browser's native API.
learning_objectives: `dataTransfer` objects, `onDragStart`, `onDragOver`, and preventing default browser drop behavior.
common_mistakes: Using inline styles instead of CSS classes.
hints: Review the documentation for the hooks mentioned in the learning objectives.
Try logging your variables to the console to see their values.

tickets.title: Context & Reducers
tickets.description: Refactor the messy drag-and-drop state into a global `useReducer`.
tasks: Refactor the messy drag-and-drop state into a global `useReducer`.
learning_objectives: Flux architecture, state reducers, and dispatching actions.
tickets.evaluation: Logic Grader strictly checks for the presence of `useReducer` and `createContext` inside the global context file.
common_mistakes: Using inline styles instead of CSS classes.
hints: Review the documentation for the hooks mentioned in the learning objectives.
Try logging your variables to the console to see their values.
